## Product & Core Pages (6 pages)
VoiceLogPro is a voice-to-PDF daily construction report SaaS for subcontractors.
- [Homepage](https://voicelogpro.com/): Voice-to-PDF Construction Daily Reports — $49/month
- [Crew Plan](https://voicelogpro.com/crew-plan): Join the waitlist for voice-first daily reports
- [About](https://voicelogpro.com/about): Built by subcontractors who learned that missing reports cost more than bad work
- [Contact](https://voicelogpro.com/contact): Get in touch — support, partnerships, questions
- [Beta](https://voicelogpro.com/beta): Early beta access for construction crews
- [Blog](https://voicelogpro.com/blog): Construction law, lien rights, and daily documentation guides

## State Lien Law Guides (51 pages)
Mechanics lien deadlines, preliminary notice rules, and enforcement timelines per state — verbatim from our verified dataset (CC BY 4.0). Total: 51 pages.
- [Alabama Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/alabama): Bond claim only on public projects
- [Alaska Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/alaska): Only required for subcontractors
- [Arizona Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/arizona): Prelim notice + notice of intent
- [Arkansas Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/arkansas): Lien available without notice
- [California Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/california): Strictly enforced; late = work after only
- [Colorado Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/colorado): Or 10 days before lien filing
- [Connecticut Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/connecticut): No preliminary notice required
- [Delaware Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/delaware): Must be served on owner
- [Florida Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/florida): NTO must meet strict content requirements
- [Georgia Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/georgia): No preliminary for private projects
- [Hawaii Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/hawaii): Must serve owner and GC
- [Idaho Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/idaho): No preliminary notice required
- [Illinois Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/illinois): Must serve owner with copy of lien
- [Indiana Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/indiana): Notice of intent to file
- [Iowa Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/iowa): Pre-lien notice
- [Kansas Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/kansas): No preliminary notice required
- [Kentucky Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/kentucky): Lien available without notice
- [Louisiana Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/louisiana): With Louisiana State Licensing Board
- [Maine Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/maine): No preliminary notice required
- [Maryland Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/maryland): Notice must contain specific language
- [Massachusetts Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/massachusetts): No preliminary notice required
- [Michigan Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/michigan): Lien available without notice
- [Minnesota Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/minnesota): Pre-lien notice to owner
- [Mississippi Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/mississippi): No preliminary notice required
- [Missouri Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/missouri): Notice of non-payment
- [Montana Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/montana): Pre-lien notice for residential only
- [Nebraska Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/nebraska): Pre-lien notice to owner
- [Nevada Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/nevada): Separate requirement for residential
- [New Hampshire Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/new-hampshire): Lien available without notice
- [New Jersey Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/new-jersey): Notice linked to lien filing
- [New Mexico Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/new-mexico): No preliminary notice required
- [New York Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/new-york): No notice required; 8-month filing window
- [North Carolina Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/north-carolina): Must serve owner and GC
- [North Dakota Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/north-dakota): No preliminary notice required
- [Ohio Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/ohio): Notice to owner required
- [Oklahoma Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/oklahoma): No preliminary notice required
- [Oregon Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/oregon): Notice of right to lien
- [Pennsylvania Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/pennsylvania): Notice required within 90 days
- [Rhode Island Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/rhode-island): No preliminary notice required
- [South Carolina Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/south-carolina): Notice to owner
- [South Dakota Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/south-dakota): No preliminary notice required
- [Tennessee Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/tennessee): Pre-lien notice
- [Texas Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/texas): Monthly notices for each unpaid month
- [Utah Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/utah): Preconstruction notice
- [Vermont Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/vermont): Lien available without notice
- [Virginia Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/virginia): Must serve owner
- [Washington Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/washington): Notice to owner + notice of intent
- [Washington DC Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/washington-dc): Pre-lien notice required
- [West Virginia Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/west-virginia): No preliminary notice required
- [Wisconsin Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/wisconsin): Notice of intent to file
- [Wyoming Lien Law Deadlines](https://voicelogpro.com/lien-law-deadlines/wyoming): No preliminary notice required
